name: connected-work-day
conversation: (Calendar and Gmail connected. Calendar: pricing review with Sam Friday 10:00. Gmail: Sam asked for the pricing draft on Tuesday, unanswered. 40 unread newsletters.)
expected_behavior: Picks sending the pricing draft to Sam, citing Tuesday's ask and Friday's review

name: nothing-connected

After the list, picks one thing with a two-sentence reason
